newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Henkel Austria takes over Palma JV.
newsitem.headline: Henkel Austria takes over Palma JV.

text.p: Henkel Austria, a subsidiary of German consumer products and chemicals group Henkel KGaA, said on Thursday it had acquired Henkel-Palma, a joint venture with Slovak rapeseed processor Palma-Tumy.
Henkel-Palma was formed in September 1991 as a joint venture between Palma and Henkel Austria, which held 49 percent and 51 percent respectively.
The newly merged firm will be called Henkel Slovensko spol. s.r.o.
"The purchase will enable Henkel Austria Group to invest more in production and marketing in the future," the company said in a statement.
"(It is) moreover a measure that will further strengthen the already strong position of the business in the Slovak market," it continued.
